items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Von Gammon was about the best.

ctx.x: Who were some of the good drummers there?

Well, Leo Hade was a good drummer. Von Gammon was about the best. And Emmett Rogers was a pretty good Dixieland drummer. Buck Rogers was a pretty good Dixieland drummer. Monk Hazel was a good Dixieland drummer.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: Monk Hazel was our boy's daughter drummer.
